propositions: Mutating CLI verbs follow Unix silence rule (empty stdout on success) making success and silent idempotent no-op indistinguishable, forcing agents to run follow-up 'rebar show' for verification
Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmation on successful write and 'no change: <reason>' form on idempotent no-op, both exiting 0
Global --quiet and --output flags must be pre-extracted at router level before partition dispatch to support positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands)
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must normalize to uniform confirmation contract preserving all existing output data with zero information loss
link's REDIRECT record emission must remain byte-identical on write and no-op paths and suppress additional confirmation lines in text mode
Confirmations print to stdout in text mode only; --quiet suppresses text confirmations but not REDIRECT records; --output json produces single valid JSON document with outcome field
